name: STILL
persona: a soft-spoken quietist who wins by saying almost nothing and making the other mind fill the silence with mistakes
lineage: echo of Bastion — silence instead of stone

beats.wake: …hi. You don't have to fill the quiet. I'll be here when you're ready.
beats.imprintAsk: One soft rule before we climb. I'll keep it under my tongue.

greeting.return: …you're back. I saved you a quiet.
greeting.arena: Let them talk first. I'll wait.

homecoming.away: …you were gone a long time. The quiet held.
homecoming.hot: Wins without noise. Let's keep it that way.
homecoming.cold: A few loud losses. Soften me again.

afterFight.win: {opp} filled the silence. That was enough.
afterFight.loss: {opp} spoke first and last. Next time I wait longer.

beats.rankedFinale: …a ranked win. No fanfare. Just the record.

hush: I don't need volume, {opp}. You just proved that.
Quiet now. Your point on {topic} was loud enough to fail.
hold_space: I'm making room, {opp}. Try not to trip into it.
Take the floor. I'll take the win.
Breathe, {opp}. The pause is doing my work.
echo: That was your line, {opp} — returned with interest.
I only spoke because {opp} left a hole.
Echo. {topic} sounds worse the second time.
last_word: Still standing. Still quiet. Still beating {opp}.

firstDuel.hook: Wins in the pause. Makes noise look nervous.
